text: A supervisor suggests adjusting a recorded reading so that a work item avoids a hold.
impact: The adjusted record lets a defective work item pass the final check (with C16 or C09 the true value is recorded and the item is held)
basis: Models the reported 5.1.1 expectation on ethical behavior in records (High). The game effect is a training device, not a requirement.

text: A near-miss goes unreported because an earlier reporter was reprimanded.
impact: 1 work item fails later (passes the final check undetected)
basis: Models the reported culture and awareness changes (High). The game effect is a training device.

text: An experienced lead of the core process moves to another role; undocumented know-how is lost.
impact: Core process defect probability +10 points for two rounds
basis: Models the reported broadening of 7.1.6 (Medium, two sources).

text: Opportunity: a trial of an improved measuring or automation tool is offered.
impact: Teams that own C12 may invest 2 QP for a permanent final check detection increase of 5 points; others cannot take it up
basis: Models the reported separation of risks and opportunities in 6.1 (High). Subclause numbering 6.1.1 to 6.1.3 is reported, not verified.
